name: Girlfriends with Benefits
source:
You wanted a normal college life—instead, you're trapped at a host club, working to pay off a mountainous debt. Your days consist of nothing but serving drinks and listening to women complain about their husbands, until one night, a girl walks in—a girl who seems genuinely interested in you!

It must be your lucky night, but then you get berated by the new female bartender and spotted by a classmate from school!

Will you ever be able to pay off this debt and find true love?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.hostbf&referrer=utm_source%3Dwebpage%26utm_campaign%3Dhostbf_web]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你本来只想过普通的大学生活，却被困在一家牛郎店，为偿还巨额债务而工作。每天不是端酒，就是听女人抱怨丈夫。直到某天夜里，一位女孩走了进来——她似乎真的对你有兴趣！

本以为今晚交了好运，你却接着遭到新来的女调酒师训斥，还被学校的同班同学撞见！

你究竟能否还清债务，找到真爱？

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.hostbf&referrer=utm_source%3Dwebpage%26utm_campaign%3Dhostbf_web]Google Play[/url]]
